components.exclude: Promotional guarantee/avoidance advice, denial, question, hypothetical or advised extra expenditure. A small reward or small saving amount alone is insufficient. Explicit positive appraisal immediately after the ironic construction overrides it.
components.include: No/poor savings, poor value, or extra expenditure. The conventional 一顿操作猛如虎 + 一看/结果 + 省了/省下/便宜了 construction is a narrow explicit rhetorical poor-value signal even when savings exceed zero.
components.interpretation: Expressed disappointing value; not an accounting estimate or actual spending record.

label_and_count_semantics.component_binary: 1 iff at least one qualifying non-overlapping phrase occurrence for that component; otherwise 0.
label_and_count_semantics.component_hit_count: Number of non-overlapping qualifying occurrences; not intensity or frequency of real behavior.
label_and_count_semantics.deduplication: Within each component, longest qualifying interval first, then earliest, then rule ID. An overlapping shorter qualifying candidate is retained as excluded. Exact same spans across rule alternatives are kept once.
label_and_count_semantics.excluded_hits: Lexical candidates retained with exclusion reason, including overlap suppression. No-candidate comments receive explicit component decision reason.
label_and_count_semantics.multi_label: Different components may overlap freely; there is no priority override between components.
label_and_count_semantics.outcome_hit_count: Sum of corresponding component counts; a composite may count the same language under multiple components. It is not a unique-event count.

normalization.algorithm: Per-source-codepoint Unicode NFKC; ASCII A-Z lowercase; each CR becomes LF; drop BOM, zero-width space, ZWNJ, ZWJ; preserve all other whitespace and punctuation. No traditional/simplified conversion, segmentation, stemming, emoji removal, or cross-codepoint composition.
normalization.span_convention: Half-open Unicode codepoint offsets, separately reported in original and normalized text. A normalized expansion maps back to its original source codepoint.
normalization.window_convention: Candidate anchors must fit wholly inside normalized text[max(0,start-45):min(n,end+45)]. Thus the 45 immediately preceding/following codepoints are eligible; the 46th is not. Anchors inside the matched phrase qualify.
